definitions.gloss: full amount; total sum; entire amount
definitions.explanation: The complete monetary amount without any deduction or reduction.

examples.japanese: {全額|ぜんがく}{返金|へんきん}します。
examples.english: We will refund the full amount.

examples.japanese: {旅費|りょひ}は{会社|かいしゃ}が{全額|ぜんがく}{負担|ふたん}する。
examples.english: The company will cover the full travel expenses.

examples.japanese: {奨学金|しょうがくきん}のおかげで、{学費|がくひ}を{全額|ぜんがく}{免除|めんじょ}してもらえた。
examples.english: Thanks to the scholarship, I had the full tuition waived.

notes:
{全額|ぜんがく} refers to the complete monetary amount with no deductions. It combines {全|ぜん} (all) + {額|がく} (amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全額|ぜんがく}{返金|へんきん}: full refund
- {全額|ぜんがく}{負担|ふたん}: bearing the full cost
- {全額|ぜんがく}{免除|めんじょ}: full exemption/waiver
- {全額|ぜんがく}{支払|しはら}う: to pay in full
- {全額|ぜんがく}{返済|へんさい}: full repayment

USAGE:
Common in business, legal, and administrative contexts. Often functions adverbially: {全額|ぜんがく}{返金|へんきん}します (We will refund the full amount).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半額|はんがく}: half price
- {総額|そうがく}: total amount, grand total
- {金額|きんがく}: amount of money (general)
